format.events: Keyed by event id. 'name' matches the event name in sailor-events/events.json.
format.kind: arena | unique | pve | trade | siege | reset | seasonal
format.rewards: Groups of reward entries. Arena groups: win, draw, defeat, kill. Other groups are named after their source (e.g. roc, deathbone). Paths read like events.unique-clash.rewards.defeat.
format.rewardEntry: item (id in 'items'), count (default 1), chance (0..1, omitted = guaranteed), max (cap per event), delivery (drop | inventory, default drop), note.
format.rewardNotes: Free text about the rewards that has no item.
format.requirements: itemPoints (minimum), maxItemPoints, level {min, max}, job (any | trader | hunter | thief), jobSuit, guild, register (NPC), noSpeedBuffs, notes.
format.items: Item id -> name and kind. kind: currency | equipment | material | consumable | booster | scroll | box | avatar | other.

flowers.name: Evil Scented, Illusion, Life, Energy and Whirling Snow Flowers

roc.name: Roc
roc.summary: Weekly boss in Roc Mountain: beat Roc, then its stronger form Deathbone.
description: Roc is a weekly unique boss in Roc Mountain. Defeat Roc, then its stronger form Deathbone, for valuable drops.
- Move to the Gate of Ruler in Roc Mountain.
- Buy a key to enter its lair.
- Enter the lair quickly as the gate will only stay open for 10 minutes.
- Once you're inside make sure to move to not be kicked out by the AFK system.

notes: Move to Gate of Ruler in Roc Mountain and buy a key to enter its lair.
Gate of Ruler is only open for a short time.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.summary: Unique boss in Jangan Cave: clear her guardians, then face Medusa.
description: Medusa is a unique boss inside the Qin Shi Tomb, otherwise known as Jangan Cave.
- Move to the Gate of Sarin Tribe in the Qin Shi Tomb at the center of level B4.
- Enter her lair quickly as the gate will only stay open for 10 minutes.
Once inside four Guardians are at the end of each arm of the cross:
- North is JeonUk The Black Tortoise
- South is YumJae The Red Hawk
- West is TaeHo The Blue Dragon
- East is SoHaow The White Tiger
- Once they are defeated Shinmoo: The Man of Flames spawns in the SW corner of the center room.
Upon defeating Shinmoo you can enter B6, kill a couple of more guardians and face Medusa!

notes: Enter the Gate of Sarin Tribe and defeat all her guardians to spawn Medusa.
Gate of Sarin Tribe is only open for a short time.

moon-gem.name: Moon Gem
moon-gem.summary: Get Moon Pots from Event So-Ok, then trade 1 pot + 10 Moon Gems for a reward.
description: Every hour from xx:50 to xx:00, Event So-Ok in every town gives out 1 to 10 Moon Pots at random.
Monsters drop Moon Gems. Trade 1 Moon Pot and 10 Moon Gems for one reward. Moon Gems also work as Vigor Potions.
Collect gems while you hunt anyway, and be in town at xx:50 to pick up your pots.

notes: Speak to Event So-Ok in any town during the event to get Moon Pots.

clash-of-the-gods.name: Clash of the Gods
clash-of-the-gods.summary: Team PvP: kill the three Egyptian Gods and Mummy waves for points.
description: A team PvP arena around three Egyptian God uniques (Anput, Satis and Wadjet) and waves of Mummy elites.
Points: a God kill gives 100 points to the player and their team, a Mummy 2 points, an enemy player 1 point.
When the first Anput spawns, 40 Mummies spawn in each team's zone. At 10, 5 and 2 minutes left, 40 more spawn in the losing team's zone.
Strategy: one God is worth 100 player kills, so the team that takes the uniques wins. The Mummy waves help a losing team catch up, so a leading team should not stop scoring.

poison-temple.name: Poison Temple
poison-temple.summary: Job-only area where three uniques spawn at once.
description: Three uniques spawn at the same time, one on each circular platform: North West, South West and South East.
Enter through the Tunnel of Abyss teleporters. Entry is only open while the uniques spawn, so wait at a teleporter before the event starts.
Strategy: pick one platform with your party instead of running between all three. Expect other job players at every platform.

sailors-clash.name: Sailors Clash
sailors-clash.summary: A team-based PvP arena event on a large scale. Claim boxes to win!
description: A team PvP arena event.
Loot boxes spawn three times during the match: at 09:30 (right at the start), 06:20 and 03:10 on the match timer.
Strategy: be near the boxes at those times. Winning the fight around a box is often worth more than chasing kills.

unique-clash.name: Unique Clash
unique-clash.summary: A team-based PvP arena event on a large scale, focus down uniques to win!
description: A team PvP arena event with unique monsters on the map.
Strategy: fight for the uniques as a team. A split team often loses both the unique and the fight.

styria-clash.name: Styria Clash
styria-clash.summary: Job-themed team PvP arena; Traders & Hunters vs. Thieves!
description: A job-themed team PvP arena event. Wear your job suit.
Loot boxes spawn three times during the match: at 09:30 (right at the start), 06:20 and 03:10 on the match timer.
Strategy: be near the boxes at those times. Winning the fight around a box is often worth more than chasing kills.

carnage-arena.name: Carnage Arena
carnage-arena.summary: Slaughter your enemies in a massive solo deathmatch!
description: A free-for-all PvP arena. Everyone fights alone, and each kill earns bonus rewards on top of the match result.
Strategy: join fights that have already started and finish weakened players. Staying alive longer gives you more chances to score.

carnage-party.name: Carnage Party
carnage-party.summary: Jump in and prove your team-play prowess in a 4v4 free-for-all!
description: A team PvP arena where the game puts you into a random team, so you need no party.
Every team has 2 CH and 2 EU players.
Strategy: you meet your team at the start, so agree on a target quickly and stay together.

ghost-hunt.name: Ghost Hunt
ghost-hunt.summary: Form parties, defend positions, and hunt ghosts in a massive team deathmatch!
description: A cooperative PvE event: players hunt ghost monsters with Talismans of Exorcism.
Buy the Talismans at the Grocery Shop before the event. Cancel all movement speed buffs before the event starts, or you can't take part.
Strategy: bring enough Talismans for the whole event, so you don't have to leave to buy more.

ba-random.name: BA Random
ba-random.summary: Dive in and fight, no preparation needed!
description: Battle Arena where the game puts you into a random team.
Good when you have no party: register alone and play.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

ba-party.name: BA Party
ba-party.summary: Form your own party ahead of time and join the fun!
description: Battle Arena where you enter with your own party.
Strategy: a party that plays together often wins against random teams, so agree on roles before the match.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

ba-guild.name: BA Guild
ba-guild.summary: Gather your guild and prove your strength!
description: Battle Arena where you enter with your guild.
The Guild Master or a deputy registers the members, so be online and ready before registration closes.

notes: The Guild Master or a deputy registers the members.

ba-flag.name: BA Flag
ba-flag.summary: Fight your enemies and capture the flag!
description: Battle Arena in capture-the-flag mode.
Strategy: split your team into attackers and defenders, so your own flag is never left alone.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

ba-job.name: BA Job
ba-job.summary: Battle Arena in Job Mode, equip your suit!
description: Battle Arena in job-themed mode. Wear your job suit.

notes: No Item Point requirement: matchmaking uses Item Points.

sa-solo.name: SA Solo
sa-solo.summary: Solo Survival Arena; show them who's strongest!
description: Survival Arena where you fight alone.
Each season grants rewards for up to 40 games. The limit carries over to the next season.

sa-party.name: SA Party
sa-party.summary: Party Survival Arena; party up and dominate!
description: Survival Arena where you fight with your party.
Each season grants rewards for up to 40 games. The limit carries over to the next season.

anubis-isis.name: Anubis & Isis
anubis-isis.summary: Job Temple bosses Anubis and Isis; entrance at Salt Post in Alexandria.
description: A Job Temple unique boss encounter with Anubis and Isis. Wear your job suit.
The Job Temple entrance is at Salt Post in Alexandria.

selket-neith.name: Selket & Neith
selket-neith.summary: Job Temple bosses Selket and Neith; entrance at Salt Post in Alexandria.
description: A Job Temple unique boss encounter with Selket and Neith. Wear your job suit.
The Job Temple entrance is at Salt Post in Alexandria.

haroeris-seth.name: Haroeris & Seth
haroeris-seth.summary: Job Temple: two Egyptian uniques of rising difficulty.
description: A Job Temple encounter with three shadow uniques of rising difficulty: Shadow Eris, Shadow Haroeris and Shadow Seth. Wear your job suit.
The Job Temple entrance is at Salt Post in Alexandria.
Strategy: save potions and your strongest skills for the last boss.

fortress-war.name: Fortress War
fortress-war.summary: Weekly guild siege: conquer a fortress and collect its towns' tax.
description: A weekly guild-vs-guild siege that lasts 60 minutes. The guild that conquers a fortress earns tax income from its towns.
Fortresses: Jangan, and Bandit (max. 2350 Item Points). Registration stays open until 19:30 GMT+2.
Dismiss your Pick Pet and Fellow Pet before you teleport into the fortress area.

notes: Pick Pet and Fellow Pet must both be dismissed to teleport into the fortress areas.
Bandit Fortress: 2350 Item Points at most.

capture-the-flag.name: Capture the Flag
description: A capture-the-flag PvP event only for characters from level 60 to 120.
Trade 10 Ice Trophies at Event So-Ok for one random reward.

special-trade-1h.name: Special Trade (1 hour)
special-trade-1h.summary: All special trade routes are open for an hour.
description: During a Special Trade, every special trade route is open. See the jobbing guide on Sailor's website for the routes.
Times (GMT+2): 02:00-03:00 daily, 15:00-16:00 (2 hours on Sunday), 20:00-22:00 (not on Sunday).
Strategy: buy your goods and be at the start of your route before the event begins, so you use the whole hour.

special-trade-2h.name: Special Trade (2 hours)
special-trade-2h.summary: All special trade routes are open for two hours.
description: During a Special Trade, every special trade route is open. See the jobbing guide on Sailor's website for the routes.
Times (GMT+2): 02:00-03:00 daily, 15:00-16:00 (2 hours on Sunday), 20:00-22:00 (not on Sunday).
Strategy: two hours are enough for more than one run, so plan a route that ends near the next start.

fence-trade.name: Fence Trade
fence-trade.summary: Special Trade for thieves, jump into Thief Town!
description: Fence Trades are Special Trades for thieves. They usually start one hour after a Special Trade. See the jobbing guide on Sailor's website.
Times (GMT+2): Thu, Fri, Sat and Sun, 03:00-04:00 and 16:00-17:00.
You need thief level 13 or higher.

calendar-reset.name: Calendar Reset
calendar-reset.summary: The attendance calendar can be claimed again.
description: The Attendance Reward Calendar resets once a day and can be claimed again.
Claim it every day: once the calendar ends, its rewards can no longer be claimed.

genie-reset.name: Genie Reset
description: Genie Reset resets the Genie Quest and the Genie Quest Manager. It is a daily quest that helps you gear up.
The reward depends on your level, from D11 Egyptian equipment at level 71 up to D12/D13 Legend equipment at level 111-130.
If you outlevel the quest, you may have to abandon it and take it again.
rewardNotes: Lv 71-90: D11 Egy A and Egy B equipment.
Lv 91-100: D11 Egy A, Egy B and D12 Magic equipment.
Lv 101-110: D11 Egy A, Egy B and D12 Magic, Rare and Legend equipment.
Lv 111-130: D12/D13 Magic, Rare and Legend equipment.

balloon-carnival.name: Balloon Carnival
balloon-carnival.summary: Collect Rubber Pieces from monsters and trade them with Jooa.
description: Carnival Manager Jooa collects Rubber Pieces. Monsters of every kind drop them all over the world.
Defeat monsters, collect Rubber Pieces and trade them with Jooa in any town for rewards.
All rewards except Avatar and Pet expire when the event ends.
rewardNotes: See the event page for the full list.
All rewards except Avatar and Pet expire when the event ends (May 31st).

notes: Speak to Jooa in any town during the event to get Balloons.
